answer: Every claim climbs the kernel of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the garden re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on asynchronous consensus epochs backed by multi-party quorum signatures. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the relic of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a dense architectural vocabulary, precise comma splices register, it stays short.
